compatibility_report_owner.name: compatibility_report_owner
compatibility_report_owner.using:
((owner_user_id = app.current_user_id()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (birth_profile primary_birth
     JOIN profile primary_profile ON ((primary_profile.id = primary_birth.profile_id)))
  WHERE ((primary_birth.id = compatibility_report.primary_birth_profile_id) AND (primary_profile.owner_user_id = app.current_user_id())))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (birth_profile comparison_birth
     JOIN profile comparison_profile ON ((comparison_profile.id = comparison_birth.profile_id)))
  WHERE ((comparison_birth.id = compatibility_report.comparison_birth_profile_id) AND (comparison_profile.owner_user_id = app.current_user_id())))))
compatibility_report_owner.withCheck:
((owner_user_id = app.current_user_id()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (birth_profile primary_birth
     JOIN profile primary_profile ON ((primary_profile.id = primary_birth.profile_id)))
  WHERE ((primary_birth.id = compatibility_report.primary_birth_profile_id) AND (primary_profile.owner_user_id = app.current_user_id())))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (birth_profile comparison_birth
     JOIN profile comparison_profile ON ((comparison_profile.id = comparison_birth.profile_id)))
  WHERE ((comparison_birth.id = compatibility_report.comparison_birth_profile_id) AND (comparison_profile.owner_user_id = app.current_user_id())))))

compatibility_report_public_share.name: compatibility_report_public_share
compatibility_report_public_share.using: ((share_token_hash = app.current_share_token_hash()) AND (share_state = 'public') AND (share_revoked_at IS NULL) AND ((share_expires_at IS NULL) OR (share_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)))

compatibility_report_token_digest_check.name: compatibility_report_token_digest_check
compatibility_report_token_digest_check.value: ((share_token_hash IS NULL) OR (share_token_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$')) AND ((public_share_payload_digest IS NULL) OR (public_share_payload_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'))

compatibility_report_share_lifecycle_che.name: compatibility_report_share_lifecycle_check
compatibility_report_share_lifecycle_che.value: ((share_state = 'public' AND report_payload IS NOT NULL AND public_share_payload IS NOT NULL AND public_share_version IS NOT NULL AND public_share_payload_digest IS NOT NULL AND share_token_hash IS NOT NULL AND share_revoked_at IS NULL) OR (share_state = 'private' AND public_share_payload IS NULL AND public_share_version IS NULL AND public_share_payload_digest IS NULL AND ((share_token_hash IS NULL AND share_expires_at IS NULL AND share_revoked_at IS NULL) OR (share_token_hash IS NOT NULL AND share_revoked_at IS NOT NULL))))

subscription_transition_state_check.name: subscription_transition_state_check
subscription_transition_state_check.value: ((transition_state_version IS NULL AND last_provider_event_occurred_at IS NULL) OR (transition_state_version = '1.0.0' AND plan_key IN ('personal', 'advanced') AND period_starts_at IS NOT NULL AND period_ends_at IS NOT NULL AND period_starts_at < period_ends_at AND last_provider_event_id ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,199}$' AND last_provider_event_occurred_at IS NOT NULL))
